changes: Offline service restart and next-workday collection can reuse a previous server-authorized member/region/role lease for up to seven days; first enrollment requires network.

Explicit authorization denials, logout, missing consent, permissions, invalid scope and expired leases stop collection. The Saudi 06:00 inclusive to 18:00 exclusive window excluding Friday remains enforced.
Pending GPS points and gaps have no automatic age expiry. Logout retains owner-bound evidence; only server-acknowledged data is removed after fresh current-owner authorization.
SQLite outboxes preserve existing points on capacity or disk-full failure; 100000 pending-point capacity rejects new fixes without eviction and records a gap when storage is available.
Authenticated historical replay retains original capture times and enforces ownership, region, role, account-creation boundary, schedule, future-time guards and idempotency.
An empty prior account can be safely replaced after server verification; pending prior-account evidence cannot be reassigned.
Service restart race and stale storage-error recovery fixed; build and download guidance are updated to Android 1.0.9.

verification.suite: mobile-route API with real isolated SQLite
offline native authorization policy and integration guards
actual Java route stores with real SQLite, capacity and disk-full rollback
actual built daily report browser, Arabic/English and mobile widths
Android resource/Java/DEX build and same-key signature validation

realDataPreview: Separate private read-only report preview uses actual authorized production data; no production report data or credentials are included in this software package.
limitations: Background GPS depends on Android permission, location availability, battery restrictions and OS lifecycle; physical company-phone testing remains required.
Offline collection lease is limited to seven days after the last successful authenticated server check. Pending point capacity is 100000; new fixes may be missed after storage fills.
Previously unrecorded GPS cannot be reconstructed. Gaps remain explicit and do not become confirmed visits.
Web/PWA background behavior is not equivalent to the Android APK. Uploading the website alone does not update installed Android native code.
